reviews.review: This is a good game to grab on sale, it's not a great game, but it will provide a couple of hours of glorious slaughter in the name of the emperor.

This is one of the most underrated third person shooters. for one is doesn't rely on hiding like a girl behind cove, 2 the world and music are amazing and the voice action is brilliant. Storyline sucks a little. The multi player was pretty fun too.

Campaign is great! The story is interesting (if you're 40kurious), and you get to wade through the blood and gore of hundreds of orks, heretics, and daemons with a myriad of classic Spahz Mareen weapons.

The multiplayer is* great fun; tons of customization options, different loadouts, and different game modes.

* - It 'was' great once, I think.
Few people play it. The vast majority of those that do are veterans, making it really.. really F'ing hard for new players to feel like they're anything other than point-fodder. That, coupled with the absolutely awful team-balancing, makes multiplayer an overly-salted experience for most. 

There's usually only one mode being played: Seize Ground (domination game). And the DLC game modes (where you get to play an actual Dreadnought!) is hardly ever played, as the only people who can play it have to buy it, and since very few people actually play the core game...

But I still love it. That's how fun it can be.

Just remember: you're gonna die. Many, many.. manymanymanymany times.
Take breaks. 
Remember the good matches and you'll find you wanna dive headfirst into the salty carnage once more.
